LanguageData.MassConsume.Enabled.Tip: Master switch. While off, the Consume command is hidden; the setting itself is kept.
LanguageData.MassConsume.DebugLevel.Tip: Cycles Off / Basic / Verbose.\n\nBasic logs menu opens and every consume order or skip. Verbose additionally logs every selection scan with a line per pawn and per item (very spammy - only for hunting a specific issue).
LanguageData.MassConsume.LogOverview.Tip: Writes the current selection to the log: every eligible drafted pawn and, for each inventory item, whether the game considers it consumable and why.
LanguageData.MassConsume.Consume.Desc: Opens a list of the food and drugs carried in the selected pawns' inventories. Pick an item and every selected pawn that carries it will consume one right away; pawns without the item do nothing.\n\nHold Shift while picking to queue the order instead of replacing the current one - repeat to line up several (meal, then beer, then go-juice).
LanguageData.MassConsume.Consume.CarriedBy: {0} of {1} selected pawns carry something consumable.
LanguageData.MassConsume.BehaviorNote: Select one or more drafted pawns and click Consume to open the shared item list. Entries show how many of the selected pawns carry each item; picking one makes every carrier consume one. Uses the game's own edibility checks - meals, raw food, drugs and modded consumables all work, nothing is hardcoded.
